transcript.text: Let me search the SailPoint MCP tools for certification/campaign APIs.
Good. Now let me get full details on the three core operations in parallel, and also search for how to pull certification decision results.
Now let me fetch details on the reports endpoint and search for per-certification item/decision results.
Let me also get details on the campaign status and run-report operations.

Here is the complete end-to-end flow for creating, activating, and pulling results from an ISC access-review (certification) campaign.

---

## Authentication

All API calls require an OAuth2 bearer token obtained via the client-credentials grant from a Personal Access Token (PAT).

```bash
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/oauth/token

# Body (application/x-www-form-urlencoded — never in query string)
grant_type=client_credentials
&client_id={pat_client_id}
&client_secret={pat_client_secret}
```

Use the returned `access_token` as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every subsequent call.

---

## Step 1 — Create the Campaign

```http
POST /v3/campaigns
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json
```

```json
{
  "name": "Q3 2026 Entitlement Review",
  "description": "Quarterly review of all active user entitlements",
  "type": "MANAGER",
  "deadline": "2026-08-31T23:59:59.000Z",
  "emailNotificationEnabled": true,
  "recommendationsEnabled": true,
  "mandatoryCommentRequirement": "NO_DECISIONS",
  "sunsetCommentsRequired": true
}
```

**Key `type` values:**

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `MANAGER` | Manager certifies their direct reports' access |
| `SOURCE_OWNER` | Source owner reviews accounts on that source |
| `SEARCH` | Flexible search-driven campaign |
| `ROLE_COMPOSITION` | Reviews the entitlements inside a role |

The response body contains the new campaign object, including its `id` (used in every subsequent call) and `status: STAGED`.

**Required scope:** `idn:campaign:manage`  
**Required user level:** `ORG_ADMIN` or `CERT_ADMIN`

---

## Step 2 — Activate the Campaign

The campaign is `STAGED` after creation. Activate it to generate individual reviewer certifications and begin the review period.

```http
POST /v3/campaigns/{id}/activate
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json
```

```json
{
  "timeZone": "America/New_York"
}
```

This submits an async job. The campaign status transitions: `STAGED → ACTIVATING → ACTIVE`.  
Poll `GET /v3/campaigns` (filtering by `id` or `name`) to confirm the `ACTIVE` status before continuing.

**Required scope:** `idn:campaign:manage`

---

## Step 3 — Poll Campaign Status (optional but recommended)

```http
GET /v3/campaigns?filters=id eq "{id}"
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

Check the `status` field in the response. Proceed to reporting once it reads `ACTIVE`.

---

## Step 4 — Trigger a Report (to generate downloadable results)

```http
POST /v3/campaigns/{id}/run-report/{type}
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

**Common `{type}` values:**

| Type | Description |
|---|---|
| `CAMPAIGN_AUDITOR_REPORT` | All decisions made so far (approve/revoke) |
| `CAMPAIGN_REMEDIATION_STATUS` | Revoke provisioning status |
| `CAMPAIGN_SELECTION_REPORT` | All items included in the campaign |

This is an async job that generates the report in the background.

**Required scope:** `idn:campaign-report:manage`

---

## Step 5 — Retrieve Report Results

```http
GET /v3/campaigns/{id}/reports
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

Returns a list of all reports for the campaign, each containing:
- `type` — the report type
- `status` — `PENDING`, `IN_PROGRESS`, or `COMPLETE`
- `lastRunAt` — timestamp of last generation
- A downloadable content reference once complete

**Required scope:** `idn:campaign-report:read` or `idn:campaign-report:manage`

---

## Complete Flow Summary

```
POST /oauth/token                           → get bearer token
POST /v3/campaigns                          → create campaign (status: STAGED)
POST /v3/campaigns/{id}/activate            → activate campaign (status: ACTIVE)
GET  /v3/campaigns                          → poll until ACTIVE
POST /v3/campaigns/{id}/run-report/{type}   → trigger report generation
GET  /v3/campaigns/{id}/reports             → retrieve report results
```

---

> **Note on versioning:** The v3 endpoints used here are canonical and supported until ~Q2 2028. SailPoint is migrating to per-service paths (`/<service>/v1/`) but v3 remains the stable surface for production use today.
